ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; surface pixels are >98% low-intensity (black/dark grey) with <2% high-intensity (white) pixels occurring in isolated scars and highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation across the visible field; distinct white curvilinear blob localized at the upper-inner quadrant of the left lobe; scattered high-contrast white focal spots located on the mid-distal region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep symmetrical V-shaped depression with a calculated interior vertex angle of approximately 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth of ~15% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels; topography is significantly more jagged and 'saw-toothed' on the outer distal thirds of both lobes compared to the regions near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex lower boundary tapering to sharply pointed, slightly hooked tips; the upper trailing edge follows a concave mathematical curve towards the center notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible as scattered, roughly circular white pixel clusters on the distal portion of the right lobe and concentrated along the extreme tips, characteristic of former barnacle attachments.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent white curvilinear abrasion detected on the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe; multiple smaller, faint linear disruptions on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular erosive tissue loss along the entire trailing edge resulting in deep, non-uniform indentations and localized white depigmentation scars.
other_distinctive_markers: Exceptionally sharp and elevated lobe tips (falate) that extend vertically above the trajectory of the main trailing edge.
